items.title: Natural Gas Cash Prices Rise as First Fall Chill Meets Outages
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices rose broadly Monday as the season’s cool shot reached the Great Lakes and Northeast, while a pipeline outage trapped Appalachian supply in the basin and held the Marcellus Shale benchmark below $1.00/MMBtu.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Nudge Higher as Curtailments Support
items.summary: Natural gas futures inched higher Monday as slipping production outweighed mild October forecasts and sagging cash prices in the East.

items.title: Appalachian Natural Gas Output Lags as $1 Cash Prices Signal Curtailments
items.summary: US natural gas production remained unusually low Monday even after a major Appalachian pipeline constraint was removed, with weak regional prices pointing to continued producer curtailments.

items.title: Altamira LNG Outage Interrupts Mexico Exports, US Feedgas Demand
items.summary: New Fortress Energy’s (NFE) Mexican LNG facility was knocked offline, interrupting production at the country’s first operating export terminal as the company works through a broader restructuring of its business.

items.title: Baker Hughes Signs Deals to Boost Venezuela’s Natural Gas, LNG Sector
items.summary: US oilfield services giant Baker Hughes has entered into two strategic agreements aimed at revitalizing Venezuela’s natural gas infrastructure, bolstering supply and potentially paving the way for the nation’s first LNG exports.

items.title: YPF Targets Late-November FID for 12 Mt/y Argentina LNG Project
items.summary: Argentina’s state energy company YPF has narrowed the timeline for a final investment decision (FID) on its proposed Argentina LNG project to late November, as US financing and contractors deepen their exposure to the Vaca Muerta Shale.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Rebound Above $3 as Supply Drops
items.summary: November natural gas futures climbed Monday morning, rebounding from an early break below $3.00/MMBtu as a sharp decline in Lower 48 supply provided support despite a mild weather outlook.

items.title: Weekly Natural Gas Spot Prices Sputter as Mild East Weather Saps Demand
items.summary: Weekly natural gas cash prices fell as weather tilted in bears’ favor and total supply, while moderating, remained sturdy by autumn standards.

items.title: EIA Storage Likely to Be Flattish Year/Year as Speculators Become More Bearish
items.summary: NGI is projecting the latest US Energy Information Administration (EIA) weekly natural gas storage report through the week ended Oct. 2 to show an injection of 79 Bcf, up 15 Bcf week/week.
